title: image_assets
description: Images that arrive with a job (stage 01_INGEST). Contract proposal: docs/visual-layer/image-assets-proposal.md. Layer (a) of the clinical-media block lives here; layer (b) is validators/media.js.

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

ref.description: reference of the image inside the job, e.g. img://job-0001/0; must be unique across images and exceptions (checked by code)

provenance.description: layer (a) of the clinical-media block (decision U24): owned_photo is not accepted here

subject.description: what the image shows, declared by the producer; patient, before_after, exam and unknown are always refused by code

attribution.description: credit and licence for stock; tool or model for a generated illustration; origin for an own photo

seal.description: a generated_illustration must carry the seal (applied); checked by code

approval_id.description: editorial.image_approvals.id, written only by human_reviewer; existence, job, ref and subject are checked by code against get_image_approvals

exceptions.description: owned_photo only, each with the id of a human approval record
